title: Great luggage storage
text: The instructions are clear. The location is great. The locker room is clean.
author: christinatF5956EP

title: A safe way to store your bags on a trip to Barcelona
text: A great help on our holiday in Spain. Application very easy to use and we found a clean, tidy enclosure and in which our doubts were resolved immediately by calling the phone indicated on the posters
author: emiliol111

title: Locker Barcelona
text: Perfect to take advantage of my last day in Barcelona. I booked it from their website very easily and intuitively, they have different sizes of lockers to be able to adapt to the needs of each client. I found very well maintained and clean place. It is also monitored by security cameras, which gave me enough confidence to leave my bags. It is well located, close to the Sagrada Familia and metro stop. I will definitely repeat.
author: jorgetD696SQ
